name: mobilis
description: Mobilis monorepo for rider, driver, admin, and backend applications.

scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -n backend,admin,rider -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:rider"
scripts.dev:web-preview: concurrently -n backend,admin,rider-web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:rider:web"
scripts.dev:web-driver-preview: concurrently -n backend,admin,driver-web -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:driver:web"
scripts.dev:full-web: concurrently -n backend,admin,rider-web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:rider:web"
scripts.dev:full-mobile: concurrently -n backend,admin,rider,driver -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:rider" "pnpm dev:driver"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mobilis/domain build && pnpm --filter @mobilis/api build && pnpm --filter @mobilis/config build && pnpm --filter @mobilis/ui build && pnpm --filter @mobilis/admin-web build && pnpm --filter @mobilis/rider-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @mobilis/driver-app typecheck && pnpm --filter backend build
